headline: Accepted consent agenda and staff reports from Chief Buxton, Assistant Chiefs Tremblay and Pouliot, and Local 789 president Cy Hebert.
summary: The Board of Fire Commission accepted the consent agenda, including the July 01, 2026 minutes, expenditure and accident reports, and two thank-you communications. The board also accepted and placed on file reports from Chief Buxton, Assistant Chief Tremblay, Assistant Chief Pouliot, and Local 789 President Cy Hebert. A draft of the Board of Fire Commission By-Laws was presented for review and discussion at the October 7, 2026 meeting.
decisions: Approved consent agenda items 26-78 through 26-82, including the July 01, 2026 minutes, reports, and communications.
Accepted Chief Buxton's August/September commission report and placed it on file.
Accepted Assistant Chief Tremblay's August/September commission report and placed it on file.
Accepted Assistant Chief Pouliot's August/September oral commission report and placed it on file.
Accepted the Local 789 discussion item and placed it on file.

 Kevin Burgess

 Business Manager Karen M. Conde

STAFF NOT PRESENT:

All stood as Commissioner Steere led the Pledge of Allegiance. 
A Moment of Silence was held for all those lost in the fire service.

REGULAR AGENDA 
 
Staff Reports: 
 
26 83 A Chief Buxton 
Chief Buxton expressed that he can address any questions regarding his submitted report and 
discussed the following: 
 Budgets 
o FY26 closed out with minimal remaining 
o FY27 tracking as expected 
 Update on e-mail and Shared File for Commission in  process 
o Fire Department Calendar will still be accessed th rough Outlook 
 Deputy Telgen Claim Update 
o Deputy Telgen’s appeal was denied.  
o Ashley Telgen met with the governor and will meet with NH Retirement Board 
Thursday, 09/03/2026 
 Reserve Ladder 5 and Reserve Engine 1 to be sold. 
o Working with Purchasing on this. 
 There have been multiple fires this summer 
 09/11 Fundraiser at Lost Cowboy on Sunday, 09/06/2 026. 
 Memorial Sunday will be October 4, 2026 at 10:00am . 
 
Motion  by Commissioner Steere to accept Item 26 83 A, Chief Buxton’s August/September 
commission report, as presented and submitted, and place on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Kelly 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
26 83 B Assistant Chief Tremblay 
Assistant Chief Tremblay expressed that he can address any questions regarding his submitted 
report and discussed the following: 
 It has been a busy summer with significant events 
 The new Engine 1 is in service. 
 Captain Perault and Director of OEM Emily Martusce llo took delivery of New Meters for the 
HazMat Team. 
 
Motion  by Commissioner Lambert to accept Item 26 83 B Assistant Chief Tremblay’s 
August/September commission report, as presented and submitted, and place on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED
Page 3 of 4 
 
 
26 72 C Assistant Chief Pouliot 
Assistant Chief Pouliot expressed that he can address any questions regarding his submitted 
report and discussed the following:  
 Oral report 
 Roof repairs have begun 
o Lake Street 
 Discovered rot and missing flashing 
 Other issues discovered 
 Rot repair being done 
o Fire Alarm will be next. 
o Then Spit Brook Road/S3 
o Hopefully they will all be done before the snow. 
 Application period for new firefighters closes 09/ 07. 
o So far there have been about 65 applications 
 2 nd  Annual Summer Nashua Fire Camp was a great success. 
 
Motion  by Commissioner Kelly to accept Item 26 83 C Assistant Chief Pouliot’s 
August/September oral commission report, as presented, and place on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Lambert 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
Discussion:  
 
26 84  Local 789   
Local 789 President Cy Hebert discussed the following: 
 The relationship Local 789 has with management is excellent. 
o It continues to go well and resolutions are found.  
o Local 789 is very happy with the collaboration. 
 Frustrated with the Workers Compensation issues 
o Concerned about the Telgen claim but working to fi nd solutions. 
 A discussion regarding Worker Compensation cases r elated to employment related cancer 
took place.  
  
Motion  by Commissioner Kelly to accept Item 26 84, as presented and placed on file. 
Seconded by Commissioner Steere 
MOTION CARRIED

25 15 Board of Fire Commission By-Laws

N/A

Remarks by Fire Commissioners 
 
Commissioner Melzzi-Golja wanted to thank NFR and the Fire Marshal’s Office Division for their 
participation in Nashua Goes Back to School. It was held at Holman Stadium this year with over 
1,700 participants. 
 
 25th Anniversary of 09/11/2001 
o Commission Melizzi-Golja stated that with the 25th Anniversary of 09/11 coming up, we 
should remember the firefighters, police and citizens who lost their lives.  
o Chief Buxton stated that the VFW is the point contact for the ceremony. Services will be 
at Station 4.
